title: 第21章
content:
画面里。淡绿的柳树下，一位清冷男子站着，他着一身简单的白衬衣黑西裤，微仰着头淡笑着，纷飞的柳絮静止在半空。一旁的湖面还倒映着男人精致修长的倒影。男人五官精致，眉眼如画，漆黑的眼眸里满是柔意；他的身形很是修长，冷白色的肌肤更显得他气质绝然。恬静，清俊。这么谪仙般的人物，美的让人舍不得碰他一下。王多多小心得抚摸上画面里男人的脸颊。他这张图，没见过。应该是私照。男人拍下这张照片的时候，心情应该很不错。但是。他为什么会出现他在相亲相册里？他也是愿意得吗？王多多愣了片刻，随之而来的是难以言喻得狂喜。他亮着眼眸冲着瘫在沙发上的王金虎大喊。“爸！爸！爸！”王多多的脸开始红温，脸上的热度迅速蔓延到耳垂，周身都在颤抖，心脏快速得跳动着。惊喜，害羞，期望，多般心情交织在一起。大脑皮层一阵酥麻。王多多觉得他要癫了。王金虎捂着额头，“我的祖宗，你又怎么了？”“我要他！”“谁？”王多多将手里的相片递给了他。“我要他，我就要他，我喜欢他。”“谁啊？”“唐乐行，我要唐乐行！”“他就是我的真命天子！”“我非他不嫁！哈哈哈哈！”整个客厅乃至整栋别墅全是王多多的声音……婚姻登记处。工作人员半蹲着身子，手里举着相机，对着一对新人拍结婚照。王多多笑弯着眼，咧着嘴，小心翼翼得将脑袋轻靠在了男人的左肩，心脏不住得加速了。好激动！谁能懂？他要和唐乐行领证啦！嗯？

王多多偏头，在男人的颈项处用力得吸了一口。几缕淡雅的清香混入空气里。香气进入鼻腔，缓缓融入他的身体。体内的血液像是被洗涤了污秽。闻多了，还特精神。王多多忍不住冲动又闻了好几下。唐乐行低垂着眼眸，瞅着肩上那颗动来动去得毛茸茸的脑袋，还像小狗似得在他颈项处嗅来问去。“你在做什么？”男人的嗓音低沉，调子微高，夹着几分苏气直击人的心肺。好听。他比王多多大2岁，26岁的年纪正是男人从青涩迈向成熟的蜕变期，别样的性感。“你好香啊”王多多脸上挂着傻笑，莫名的痴汉。“你是什么味儿的信息素啊？”“又淡又舒服，让人闻了又想闻。”有点子上头啊。唐乐行抿了抿淡色的薄唇，浓密的剑眉轻抬。“你不觉得这么闻一个alpha，很不礼貌，很不矜持吗？”这就好比是一个alpha在街上拉住一个漂亮omega，上去强吻了一口，顺便再来一句，我还能再亲一下吗?只是现在角色互换了一下。性骚扰的是面前这个omega。“那有什么，领了证，你就是我的alpha了。”王多多厚着脸皮在男人颈项处又细细闻了起来。他着迷得闭上眼眸，舒服的直哼哼。这表情就像猫咪闻着猫薄荷似的，飘飘欲仙。唐乐行冷冷得伸出右手，纤细的食指抵住他不规矩的脑袋，“坐好。”“额”王多多不乐意的双手抱胸，昂着圆脸，脸上有些不服气“刚才那个大叔还说了，让我们靠近一点，结婚证就是要亲密一点得，不然照片不好看的。”唐乐行淡淡道，“你这样也太近了，坐直。”王多多心不甘情不愿得摆正了脑袋。他挺直着腰杆，嘴巴撅着快要顶到天花板了。拍照的工作人员正要按下按键，又顿住，起身。“还是不行，二位怎么都不笑了，刚刚这个小朋友不是笑得挺开心的吗？”“哼！”王多多别过脸，不爽得态度很明显。“哟吼，吵架了。”“闹别扭了。”几个工作人员闻言都纷纷都过来凑热闹。

in the screen.Under the light green willow tree, a cold man stood. He was wearing a simple white shirt and black trousers. He raised his head slightly and smiled lightly. The flying catkins were still in the air.The man's delicate and slender reflection was still reflected on the lake nearby.The man has exquisite facial features, picturesque eyebrows, and dark eyes full of tenderness; his figure is very slender, and his cold white skin makes him even more elegant.Quiet and handsome.Such an immortal figure is so beautiful that people can't bear to touch him.Wang Duoduo carefully touched the cheek of the man in the picture.I have never seen this picture of his.It should be a private photo.The man must have been in a good mood when he took this photo.but.Why does he appear in the blind date album?Is he also willing to get it?Wang Duoduo was stunned for a moment, followed by indescribable ecstasy.He shouted at Wang Jinhu who was slumped on the sofa with bright eyes."Dad! Dad! Dad!" Wang Duoduo's face began to turn red and warm, and the heat on his face quickly spread to his earlobes. His whole body was trembling, and his heart was beating fast.Surprise, shyness, expectation, various emotions are intertwined.The cerebral cortex felt numb.Wang Duoduo thought he was going crazy.Wang Jinhu covered his forehead, "My ancestor, what's wrong with you?" "I want him!" "Who?" Wang Duoduo handed him the photo in his hand."I want him, I want him, I like him." "Who is it?" "Tang Lexing, I want Tang Lexing!" "He is my Mr. Right!" "I won't marry him unless I marry him! Hahahaha!" The voice of Wang Duoduo filled the entire living room and even the entire villa... Marriage Registration Office.The staff squatted half-crouched, holding cameras in their hands, taking wedding photos of the newlyweds.Wang Duoduo smiled, rolled his eyes, grinned, and carefully leaned his head on the man's left shoulder. His heart couldn't help but accelerate.So excited!Who can understand?He is going to get the certificate with Tang Lexing!Um?

Wang Duoduo tilted his head and took a strong breath on the man's neck.A few wisps of elegant fragrance mixed into the air.The aroma entered his nose and slowly integrated into his body.The blood in the body seems to have been washed away from dirt.After hearing it too much, I feel very energetic.Wang Duoduo couldn't help but sniffed it impulsively several times.Tang Lexing lowered his eyes, looking at the furry head on his shoulder that was moving around, sniffing around his neck like a puppy."What are you doing?" The man's voice was low and slightly high-pitched, with a hint of sourness that directly struck people's heart and lungs.Nice to hear.He is 2 years older than Wang Duo. The age of 26 is the period of transformation for men from youth to maturity, and he is sexy in a different way."You smell so good." Wang Duoduo had a silly smile on his face, looking inexplicably crazy."What kind of pheromone do you smell?" "It's light and comfortable, making people want to smell it again." There's something about it.Tang Lexing pursed his thin, pale lips and raised his thick sword-shaped eyebrows."Don't you think it's rude and rude to smell an alpha like this?" This is like an alpha grabbing a beautiful omega on the street and kissing her forcefully. By the way, can I kiss her again? It's just that the roles are reversed now.The one who is sexually harassing is the omega in front of me."What's the matter? After you get the certificate, you will be my alpha." Wang Duoduo shamelessly smelled the man's neck again.He was so fascinated that he closed his eyes and hummed comfortably.This expression is like a cat smelling catnip, and it's ecstatic.Tang Lexing stretched out his right hand coldly, and pressed his slender index finger against his irregular head, "Sit tight." "Um" Wang Duoduo crossed his arms unhappily, with a round face raised and a little unconvinced, "The uncle just said, let's get closer, the marriage certificate must be intimate, otherwise the photo will not look good." Tang Lexing said lightly, "You are too close like this, sit up straight." Wang Duoduo reluctantly straightened his head.He straightened his back and pouted, almost touching the ceiling.The staff member taking the photo was about to press the button, then paused and stood up."It still doesn't work. You two didn't laugh at all. Didn't the kid laugh very happily just now?" "Humph!" Wang Duoduo turned away, his displeasure was obvious."Hey, there's a quarrel." "It's awkward." After hearing this, several staff members came over to join in the fun.
